events.title: Walk-Off 199X's demo is out!
events.summary: The demo for Walk-Off 199X is out! It took me 40 minutes to finish one run from start to end, and it gives you a pretty good idea of what the game is like. Play it now!

events.title: "Seems interesting but I don't know baseball" - Dev Diary #4
events.summary: Walk-Off 199X is a baseball game, but a lot of people don’t know anything about baseball. Not “don’t know the infield fly rule”. More like “don’t know what a strike is”. events.title: Pick Your Poison - Dev Log #3
events.summary: Sometimes, if I’m playing a game like Balatro, I spend an hour building a deck around a specific strategy (let’s say face cards), and then a boss that counters that strategy (such as The Plant) shows up. Or I’m building a big shiv deck in Slay The Spire, and the act boss is Time Eater, who ends my turn every 12 cards. events.title: Only The Walk-Off, Please - Dev Log #2
events.summary: The most important change is cutting off 88.88% of a regular baseball game. 24 of the usual 27 outs. Put quite simple, baseball takes a while. I wanted a snappy game with 45-60 minute runs. A normal baseball match is maybe halfway done in that time, and I wanted the player to go through at least half a dozen of those. events.title: Why's it called Walk-Off 199X, anyway? - Dev Log #1
events.summary: Because you gotta walk off the opponent to win. Duh. One inning, three outs, that's that. Win or lose. That’s all for this dev diary.
